description: This Java source file defines the Android activity 'JobWorkServiceActivity' which provides a UI for enqueueing work items to a JobScheduler linked to 'JobWorkService'. It includes button handlers to enqueue different intents and a kill button to simulate service termination.

classes.name: JobWorkServiceActivity
classes.description: Main activity providing UI buttons to enqueue work to 'JobWorkService' and a button to kill the process.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up JobScheduler, and assigns button click listeners.

methods.name: mEnqueue1Listener
methods.description: Enqueues a work item with intent 'com.example.android.apis.ONE'.

methods.name: mEnqueue2Listener
methods.description: Enqueues a work item with intent 'com.example.android.apis.TWO'.

methods.name: mEnqueue3Listener
methods.description: Enqueues a work item with intent 'com.example.android.apis.THREE'.

methods.name: mKillListener
methods.description: Kills the current process to simulate service termination.

search-terms: Button click handlers for enqueueing work
